editorial.blurb: Atsumeru is an intimate, expertly executed multi-course dining experience that moves from basement bites to upstairs sophistication, with thoughtful service and Northern Japanese fusion cuisine that impresses even seasoned Michelin diners.
editorial.insiderTip: Request the vegetarian menu if you prefer lighter courses, and arrive ready to move between the basement and upstairs dining areas as the meal progresses; call ahead to confirm their current BYOB policy or wine program.
